Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of low back strain. The mechanism of
injury is consistent with the reported force of the crash, and the presenting symptoms align closely with that mechanism. Over the
course of care the patient completed 42 visits, following a conservative and typical treatment progression that included manual
therapy, targeted exercise, and home program instruction. Visit frequency tapered steadily as symptoms resolved and functoinal
mobility returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. No prior
injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider or documetned in the available records. Billing for
services rendered reflects single, appropriately sequenced charges with no repeated procedures. Patient was discharged from
active care with a favorable prognosis and instructed to continue independent exercise as needed.
